candidate_scope: conditional prior-selected per-scan union; not full catalogue
location_scope: fixed finalists supplied by shared-position comparison
validation_scope: conditional reused randomized evaluation; not untouched validation
uncertainty_model: training-only per-track MAD scatter about linear CFO trend, combined in quadrature with predeclared 250 Hz floor; sensitivity model, not calibrated uncertainty
fractional_timing: exact 0.25 s propagated state grid with linear state interpolation
